review_kind: read-only source and product journey review

checks.journey: Owner opens existing v0.2 workspace after additive migration
checks.expected: Learner drafts, immutable attempts, prior decisions, invitations and moderation reasons survive unchanged; no automatic directory opt-in
checks.status: pending final build evidence

checks.journey: Learner previews and opts into directory for cohort A
checks.expected: Exact displayed name, bio, focus and chosen audience are understood before save; cohort B and unrelated staff get no listing or private data
checks.status: source gap: displayed-name preview missing

checks.journey: Learner opts out; owner removes member; learner withdraws and later rejoins
checks.expected: Listing and joining data disappear immediately; old listing audiences and RSVP seats do not silently reactivate
checks.status: candidate pure/API vectors exist; final Worker evidence pending

checks.journey: Two accounts reserve the final session place concurrently
checks.expected: One commit succeeds and one conflicts; loser reload preserves input and a deliberate retry sees full capacity
checks.status: candidate API vector exists; final Worker/browser evidence pending

checks.journey: Host cancels while learner reserves a place
checks.expected: Shared revision orders outcomes; cancelled event cannot accept a subsequent booking or reveal joining instructions; cancellation reason is visible to affected participants
checks.status: pending final build evidence

checks.journey: Cohort is paused or host authority is revoked
checks.expected: Card states the specific unavailable condition, reserves no new place, permits authorized protective cancellation, and explains cancel/recreate host repair
checks.status: source gap: paused card label and explicit repair explanation

checks.journey: Host schedules an impossible or invalid calendar date
checks.expected: Reject normalized impossible dates, nonfuture times, end before start, duration over three hours and invalid capacity without changing the workspace
checks.status: round-trip fix appears in source; final retest pending

checks.journey: Host records and corrects attendance after start
checks.expected: Only permitted host records an eligible confirmed-at-start registration; corrections retain reasons/history; learner sees own mark only; course progress and records remain unchanged
checks.status: pure candidate vector exists; final evidence pending

checks.priority: declare or fix before private release
checks.journey: Participant leaves cohort after actually attending
checks.expected: Own past attendance is readable/exportable without peer roster, joining instructions or host platform subject; authorized historical marking remains possible under the declared policy
checks.status: source differs from design: current eligibility required and former history absent

checks.journey: Workspace reaches ordinary storage/history budget then owner contains unsafe content or access
checks.expected: Member removal, scope reduction, invitation revocation, pause, hide, directory opt-out and session/RSVP cancellation succeed within explicit reserve; no evidence is dropped
checks.status: candidate fixes and isolated tests exist; final Worker evidence pending

checks.journey: Owner and scoped moderator paginate archived history across overflow and a concurrent mutation
checks.expected: Each retained event appears once in order; loser has no orphan archive; replay does not duplicate; role/scope removal affects reads immediately
checks.status: 12 SQLite probes reported; candidate API vector pending execution

checks.journey: Keyboard learner navigates and opens/closes each new dialog
checks.expected: One main landmark, useful navigation focus, modal containment and return focus; failed save announces error and retains input
checks.status: accessibility review/candidate exists; final browser evidence pending

checks.journey: Phone learner enlarges all body/input text to 200 percent
checks.expected: No document overflow or clipped dialog actions; measured body/input text doubles, not merely rem headings
checks.status: stronger candidate accessibility check pending execution

checks.journey: Learner returns after one/two lessons or pending practical/appeal
checks.expected: Correct first incomplete activity or feedback opens without jumping tabs after routine save; exhausted/suspended/paused states offer a valid next action
checks.status: resume helper now appears in source; targeted evidence pending

checks.journey: Learner saves work reflection with omitted, zero or one-sided times
checks.expected: Omitted times remain null, explicit zero stays zero, display says self-reported example and produces no verified productivity claim
checks.status: nullable copy/fields appear in source; targeted evidence pending

checks.journey: New version changes lesson/rubric labels while an old attempt awaits review
checks.expected: Old enrollment, assessment, feedback, record and export resolve original immutable content; new offering pins its selected version
checks.status: design only; current static imports need registry integration

checks.journey: Learner uses wrong pathway/Health/mismatched grant and then withdraws permission
checks.expected: Server rejects unsupported mappings and unauthorized tests; only chosen fields and current status appear; old receipts remain labelled local historical snapshots
checks.status: 21 candidate helper tests reported; app/API/browser integration unimplemented

checks.journey: Actual invited recipient reaches private hosted Academy and accepts
checks.expected: Hosting permission and Academy invitation are independently satisfied; trusted identity established and client-spoofed headers cannot impersonate accounts
checks.status: unverified; local fixtures do not establish hosted identity

checks.journey: Farmer/MSME/public-service representative completes actual chosen task with planned assistance
checks.expected: Useful corrected artifact, information classification and verification demonstrated; draft limits understood; interventions and field barriers recorded
checks.status: UAT not run; three English draft pathways are not all-audience validation

checks.journey: Assessment disagreement, misleading forum material or access problem needs help
checks.expected: Named staff, calibrated rubric, independent reviewer and monitored escalation respond through agreed process; no invented SLA or support completion
checks.status: staffing/operations decisions and observed handoffs pending

scope_exclusions_to_keep_visible: no clinical pathway or patient-data connection
no embedded AI or employer tool approval service
no live partner identity, webhook or transmitted return
no event provider, direct message, email reminder or recording
no tested wide-rollout capacity, restore or accessibility conformance
